rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a cosmetic fingernail treatment.

example.english: I'm going to a beauty salon for a manicure today.
example.traditional: 我今日去美容院做修甲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 heoi3 mei5 jung4 jyun2 zou6 sau1 gaap3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese verb for giving someone a manicure or having your nails manicured.

example.english: I go to the salon for a manicure every month.
